exposure: Maternal glucose levels/GDM status based on different diagnostic criteria (Finnish, IADPSG, NICE)
outcome: Composite of adverse neonatal outcomes (neonatal hypoglycaemia, hyperbilirubinaemia, birth trauma, perinatal mortality)
cohort: 4,939 singleton pregnant women who participated in a 75g 2-hour oral glucose tolerance test (OGTT) in six delivery hospitals in Finland in 2009.
finding: The risk of adverse neonatal outcomes was not increased in mild untreated hyperglycaemia compared to normoglycaemic controls, and was lower than in the treated GDM groups.
